subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: When models.providers.ollama.apiKey is an explicit SecretRef that is unavailable, must Ollama web search fail before any request rather than fall through to an ambient OLLAMA_API_KEY?
rationale: The patch is correct under the documented fail-fast SecretRef model, but landing it intentionally removes a credential fallback that existing mixed setups may currently rely on, so the compatibility and credential-boundary choice needs explicit human ownership.

options.title: Fail closed for explicit refs
options.body: Treat an unavailable configured SecretRef as authoritative misconfiguration and block all requests, preserving ambient fallback only when no explicit ref is configured.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep the current fallback for compatibility, accepting that an unavailable explicit ref may silently route search with a different ambient cloud credential.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for explicit refs
recommendation.body: Treat an unavailable configured SecretRef as authoritative misconfiguration and block all requests, preserving ambient fallback only when no explicit ref is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion directly asks steipete to decide this exact compatibility and credential-precedence policy.
